headline: Serbia's Eagles Soar to Record Breeding Success
meta_description: Eastern imperial eagles, Serbia's national bird, achieved their best breeding season on record in 2026 with 29 territorial pairs.
summary_short: Serbia's national bird reached a historic milestone in 2026, with eastern imperial eagles establishing 29 territorial pairs and successfully fledging 25 chicks.
body:
Serbia's eastern imperial eagles—the country's national bird—achieved their best breeding season on record in 2026, with 29 territorial pairs establishing nests across the nation.

The success extended beyond mere numbers. Of those 29 pairs, 25 chicks were successfully fledged, marking a significant milestone for a species that depends on careful conservation efforts. The result represents not just a single season's fortune, but tangible progress in the long-term protection of these magnificent raptors.

For conservationists working to restore eagle populations across the Balkans, this breakthrough offers genuine hope. The 2026 season demonstrates that targeted breeding programs and habitat protection can yield measurable results, transforming recovery from an abstract goal into documented reality.

Best breeding season on record for the species
